summary: Cleared 35 stale evolution proposals from the backlog and hardened the evolution-proposal-evaluate job with reality-checks to prevent future pile-ups. The evaluate job now verifies MEMORY.md state, filters duplicates, and rejects stale suggestions before approving anything.
actions: Enhanced evolution-proposal-evaluate job with reality-check logic
Added MEMORY.md size validation (reject if already under 2000 words)
Added stale proposal detection (reject if source problem already solved)
learnings: Proposal evaluation jobs need reality-checks to filter non-issues before approval (e.g., memory cleanup when file is already clean)
Duplicate and stale proposal accumulation can be prevented with pre-flight validation rather than post-approval cleanup
